key_reasoning.reason: The Alembic migration drops and recreates the ck_model_whitelist_requires_default CHECK constraint on codemie.applications, and its downgrade is a deliberate no-op, so it cannot be rolled back. Service changes (default_model validation, NULL allowed_models at creation) follow existing ProjectService validation patterns.
Scored S: the change is confined to ProjectService (update_allowed_models validation and the project-creation storage path) plus one migration, and the pattern is clear.
